in_marathi.name: Jeetesh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jeetesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jeetesh is a name derived from the Sanskrit root ‘jeet’ meaning victory or success. In Hindu mythology, Jeetesh is a name of Lord Vishnu, the preserver of the universe, signifying his victorious and all-powerful nature.
